title: Goldshire
line: The village by the inn: its land for your Den's server, and the doodads around the inn as Den props.
comment: Map 0 (Eastern Kingdoms) around the Lion's Pride Inn (game_tele 435, -9448.55, 68.24, 56.32): grid tiles 49-50 x 31-32. The layout takes the doodads within 28 yards of the inn's door that have a GameObjectDisplayInfo row (lamp posts, barrels, crates, fences, carts), positions from the inn. Their facing is to verify in game.
